brief:
Trial proceedings began Friday in Istanbul against 35 Israeli officials, including Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir and Defense Minister Israel Katz, Shehab Wire reported. The charges relate to attacks on the Gaza-bound convoy.

The court session marks the first hearing in what appears to be a legal action tied to Israel's 2010 raid on the Mavi Marmara aid ship, which killed nine Turkish activists and sparked a major diplomatic crisis between Turkey and Israel.
dek: Trial proceedings began Friday in Istanbul against 35 Israeli officials, including Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir and Defense Minister Israel Katz, Shehab Wire reported.
title: Turkey opens trial of 35 Israeli officials over Gaza flotilla raid
